name: s3-meter
fault_schedule: known-size request/response, HTTP403, truncated response, partial downstream write, canceled before transport and while upstream waits; signed PUT/GET/404 against scoped pinned MinIO
assertions: Signed Host/method/escaped path/query/body survive proxy; known request and response bytes match.
Partial transfers, aborted responses, cancellations and transport errors cannot count as completed operations.
Actual signed SDK operations through proxy succeed on local MinIO; fixed bounded counters report attempts and body bytes only.
limitations: Local HTTP emulator proof only; no direct AWS validation, billing estimate, headers/TLS/socket byte accounting or persistent proxy storage.
Body byte totals include only finalized attempts; in-flight count marks incomplete observation windows.
HTTP client/transport retries that re-enter the proxy count as separate attempts; automatic upstream transport retries within one attempt are not separate inbound attempts.
